jobs.description: We're building the future of urban stays. One city at a time.Homaris exists to solve one of the most persistent problems in modern cities: People from abroad need places to live, work, and just feel at home. We build and operate fully digitised serviced apartments across Germany´s major cities – next step: Europe and beyond.And a product vision — the nanopartment® — that reimagines what urban stays can look like in the smallest possible space. Revenue triples within two years — organically. No venture capital. No exit strategy. We are in this for the long run, and we build accordingly. Extraordinary people make this happen - and we're looking for one more.Your RoleYou are the person business customers and corporate partners know by name. You take an enquiry from the first message to a complete, accurate reservation, and you make sure the stay runs as promised.This is not an inbox role. You own the process end to end. You work closely with Sales, Reservations, Revenue and Operations, so every booking is commercially sound, correctly recorded and delivered without friction. Our corporate customers experience one team, and you are the reason why.What You'll DoAnswer with clarity. You respond to guests, business customers and partners quickly, precisely and with a solution in mind.Make the offer, then follow up. You create tailored offers and take them to a decision. You do not wait to be asked twice.Guide the full journey. From reservation through changes, cancellations and invoicing, you are the reference point for every question.Coordinate the details. Special requests reach the right team at the right time. Nothing is lost between departments.Back the Sales team. You handle corporate enquiries, offers and account requests, so Sales can focus on closing.Protect the terms. Rates, codes and company requirements are applied exactly as agreed. Every final booking reflects the commercial conditions.Keep accounts current. Negotiated rates, contracts and account information are accurate and up to date.Own the large bookings. You prepare offers for company stays, apartment contingents and group or high-volume bookings, and you bring them to a close.Keep the data clean. Booking, guest and company data are accurate in every relevant system. Reservation quality is your responsibility.Spot the gap early. You use digital and AI tools to find issues before they become problems.Fix the process, not the symptom. When something slows the team down, you redesign the workflow.Build what scales. You create lightweight templates and workflows that make booking faster, clearer and easier to scale.What Makes You a FitRelevant experience. You have worked in reservations, hotel sales, serviced apartments, hospitality, travel or customer service, and you have a clear drive to learn fast. Corporate, group or business-customer experience is a strong advantage.Composure under pressure. You prioritise several moving requests without losing pace or accuracy. When priorities shift, you stay structured and pragmatic.Commercial confidence. You know rates, offers and booking conditions, and you understand their impact on the business.Fluent communication. You write and speak German and English fluently, in writing and by phone.Tool confidence. You work confidently with reservation, property-management and CRM systems.Curiosity about AI. You already use digital and AI-supported tools to draft, summarise, research and automate, with sound judgement and strict attention to data privacy.Ownership. You see what needs doing and you do it. You challenge existing ways of working and help the team move forward.Presence. You are based in Berlin, or ready to be, and you value working together in person.The EnvironmentHomaris is a company with the maximum of long-term orientation. We don't burn cash to grow fast and sell. We build something real, and we expect the people who join us to want to build it with us — not to optimise for others. The pace is high. The problems are real. The team is small enough that every person matters. We're not always great at seeing and celebrating our wins. But we're working on it — and we'd love your help with that.What We OfferWe define levels by the work you own and the decisions you're accountable for, not by your title or years of experience. Beyond that: we've thought carefully about what people actually need to do their best work and live well — and we've built a benefits package that reflects that. Health, mobility, development, flexibility, and a few perks that come with being in the travel and hospitality business. Not much is missing. We'll walk you through the details when we meet.Next StepsIf this opportunity resonates with you, we’d be glad to learn more about your experience and perspective. Just send us your CV.Questions? Reach out to Natalie at karriere@homaris.de or +49 157 92465807. With more than 4,500 apartments secured under contract in cities including Berlin, Hamburg, Munich, Cologne, Frankfurt, Stuttgart, Düsseldorf and Dresden, Homaris ranks among Germany’s leading serviced-apartment brands. The company serves contemporary customer segments, including business travellers, tourists, digital nomads and corporate clients.The Homaris concept is based on the integration of a fully digitalised guest journey with maximum space efficiency, multifunctional design and intelligent space solutions. The nanopartment® is Homaris’s signature product, embodying innovative space efficiency, modern minimalism and a modular design concept that combines living, working and a sense of arrival within a compact footprint. jobs.occupation: Compliance Coordinator (all genders) (Wirtschaftsinformatiker/in (Hochschule))
jobs.description: What we are looking forBecome part of Fairmas as a Junior Compliance Coordinator (all genders) and help us build a solid foundation for our information security management system. The role sits at the intersection of compliance, information security, process management, and documentation — coordinating requirements, structuring evidence, and making our processes audit-ready. You will work closely with management, IT, HR, legal, and data protection, acting as a coordinating and documenting function rather than the sole owner of all information security.Location:Based in Berlin | Full-time or part-time | Monday to Friday | Work-life balance guaranteed.Do you have a sharp eye for detail, a talent for turning complex requirements into clear documentation, and a genuine interest in information security and compliance? Do you enjoy staying on top of open tasks, deadlines, and responsibilities across multiple teams?Then Fairmas is the right place for you.What we have in store for you• Balance: No weekend work, no shifts, no overtime.• Appreciation: Fair pay and a safe working environment.• Flexibility: Work remotely and from our modern Berlin office – 3 days/week in the office required.• Understanding: Many of us come from the hotel industry ourselves.• Purpose: Help hotels around the world stay economically successful.• Sustainability: Our offices are eco-friendly and perfectly connected.• Mobility: We subsidize your Deutschlandticket.• Growth: Through team events and personal development – we support what makes you unique.Your background• Foundation: Degree/ background in business law, IT law, business informatics, compliance, quality management, or a related field — or a relevant lateral entry from data protection, audit support, or process management.• Compliance mindset: Ability to read, understand, and translate requirements from standards, contracts, and regulations into tasks and documentation.• Security interest: First exposure to ISO 27001, information security, data protection, or audit processes is a plus• IT fluency: You don’t need to be a sysadmin, but you understand basic IT and security concepts such as user and access management, cloud systems, backup, change management, and incident management, and communicate confidently with technical colleagues.• Writing strength: Excellent written German and English; able to document complex topics clearly, precisely, and in an audit-ready way.• Structure: Systematic, thorough, and reliable — you keep track of open points, deadlines, and responsibilities without being prompted.• Collaboration: Professional and clear communicator with management, IT, legal, HR, and data protection stakeholders.• Discretion: High sense of responsibility when handling sensitive information.• Tools: Experience with tools such as Confluence, Jira, SharePoint, Notion, Excel, or GRC tools is a benefit.• Regulatory knowledge: Basic knowledge of GDPR, IT law, data protection law, or contract review is a plus• Industry background: Experience in a software, SaaS, or IT-oriented company is an advantage.• Employment Eligibility: Must be legally authorized to in Germany.How you make an impact• ISMS Development: Support the setup, structuring, and maintenance of our ISO 27001-compliant information security management system — as a coordinating and documenting function in close exchange with management, IT, HR, legal, and data protection.• Requirements Analysis: Break down ISO 27001 controls, identify gaps, assign responsibilities, and track required evidence.• Documentation: Create, revise, and maintain policies, process descriptions, work instructions, checklists, and audit evidence documents.• Audit Preparation: Compile and organize audit materials; ensure all required evidence is in place and traceable.• Task Tracking: Maintain an up-to-date action and task plan including status, owners, deadlines, and open items.• Risk Management: Assist with gap analyses, risk assessments, and documenting risk treatment measures.• Cross-Team Coordination: Gather information and coordinate with IT, HR, legal, data protection, management, and relevant departments.• Process Documentation: Document security processes such as access management, change management, incident management, backup, vendor management, asset management, and awareness programs.• Follow-Through: Track and close open points from internal reviews, external consultations, audits, and management decisions.• Stakeholder Communication: Prepare clear decision bases and summaries for management and business units.Get in Touch! Ready to Join Us? Send us your CV – feel free to include your earliest possible start date. If you have any questions, reach out to us at hr@fairmas.com – we’re happy to help.You don’t meet every single requirement or have gaps in your resume? No problem!Apply anyway – what matters most to us are your motivation, values, and personality.About usFairmas GmbH and its affiliates is a hotel software company specializing in web-based solutions for financial planning, controlling, and management reporting. Since our founding in 2003 in Berlin, our dedicated team, including hoteliers, IT experts, and professionals from a variety of backgrounds, has been supporting more than 18,000 users across 5,500 hotels worldwide.We take pride in delivering first-class service built on years of experience. At Fairmas, we foster a company culture defined by transparency, mutual respect, and strong team spirit. For us, work-life balance isn’t just a buzzword — it’s essential to maintaining long-term motivation and creativity. We firmly believe that our employees are the driving force behind Fairmas, and their ideas and contributions actively shape our company’s future.
